description: Healthcare data interoperability platform. Transforms HL7 v2.x (30 types), C-CDA R2.1 (9 documents), and X12 5010 (13 transactions) into validated FHIR R4 bundles with US Core 6.1.0 and CMS 0057-F profile compliance. Includes preflight validation, HIPAA-compliant quarantine, and audit logging.
